caveat: These same periods and recipes were inspected in prior research. Automation repeats a bounded development procedure; it does not create an untouched holdout or establish a reliable accuracy improvement. Cold independent fits may differ slightly from the earlier warm-start implementation.
dataFence: Only observations dated strictly before as-of minus one calendar day are available to the procedure. Each historical prediction fits exclusively before target date minus one calendar day. Target outcomes never enter their own predictions.
sourcePolicy: Use validated original Football-Data results and the last accepted consistent league-summary xG snapshot. Pin exact source hashes and show real xG coverage, missingness and last-match date even when sources are stale. Missing xG falls back to actual goals without dropping a fixture. Workload stays excluded until its complete scope is verified.
cachePolicy: Whole-procedure reuse requires unchanged model-relevant inputs, eligible cohort, recipes and implementation. Per-prediction reuse additionally binds the exact consumed past goal/xG rows, Elo history, fixture identity and training cutoff. Verify cached bytes and distributions; corrupt entries must be recomputed. Changed historical observations invalidate affected predictions.
selectionRule: Select minimum validation log loss among the two challengers only if it improves the fixed xG reference by more than numerical noise and does not reduce top-outcome accuracy on the identical eligible fixtures. Persist selection before evaluating only the selected challenger on the retrospective audit. Keep the reference if none qualifies.
auditGate: Require lower Brier and log loss and no lower top-outcome accuracy on identical audit fixtures. Always report current-season monitoring and day-clustered intervals. A retrospective pass is only a research result, not authorization to change the primary model.
output: Immutable versioned reports, source provenance, timings, cache statistics and a retained last successful report. An unchanged run is a check of previously evaluated inputs, not new training or new evidence.
